MATCH (petyr:Character {name: 'Petyr Baelish'})<-[:killedBy]-(victim:Character) WITH victim OPTIONAL MATCH (victim)<-[:hasMother]-(child:Character) RETURN victim.name, count(child) as mother_count
MATCH (teacher:Character {name: "Guan Yin"})-[:hasStudent]->(student:Character) RETURN student.name, student.country_of_citizenship
MATCH (a:Character)-[:hasStudent]->(b:Character), (a)-[:killedBy]->(b) RETURN a.name, a.occupation
MATCH (stannis:Character {name: "Stannis Baratheon"})-[:hasSpouse]-(spouse:Character)-[:diedIn]->(location:Location) RETURN location.name
MATCH (jiao:Character {name: "Jiao Bing"})-[:killedBy]->(killer:Character) RETURN killer.name, killer.gender
MATCH (victim:Character)-[:hasFather]->(father:Character), (victim)-[:killedBy]->(father) RETURN victim.name, victim.country_of_citizenship
MATCH (u:FictionalUniverse {name: "World of Ice and Fire"})<-[:fromUniverse]-(c:Character)-[:killedBy]->(ellaria:Character {name: "Ellaria Sand"}) RETURN COUNT(DISTINCT c.gender)
MATCH (euron:Character {name: "Euron Greyjoy"})-[:killedBy]->(killer:Character)-[:hasFather]->(father:Character) RETURN father.name
MATCH (stick:Character {name: "Stick"})-[:hasStudent]->(student:Character)-[:memberOf]->(org:Organization) RETURN DISTINCT org.name
MATCH (c:Character)-[:diedIn]->(l:Location {name: "Chang'an"}), (c)-[:hasStudent]->(student:Character {name: "Gu Yong"}) RETURN c.name
MATCH (c:Character {name: "Trixie Heeler"})-[:hasSpouse]-(spouse:Character) RETURN spouse.name, spouse.gender
MATCH (child:Character)-[hasFather]->(father:Character), (child)-[killedBy]->(father) RETURN DISTINCT father.name, father.birth_name
MATCH (c:Character)-[:diedIn]->(loc:Location {name: "Highgarden"}), (c)-[:hasSpouse]-(spouse:Character {name: "Luthor Tyrell"}) RETURN c.name
MATCH (c:Character)-[:diedIn]->(l:Location) RETURN DISTINCT l.name
MATCH (c:Character)-[:memberOf]->(:Organization {name: "Weapon X"}), (c)<-[:hasFather|:hasMother]-(:Character {name: "Jimmy Hudson"}) RETURN DISTINCT c.name
MATCH (iw:Organization {name: "Infinity Watch"})-[:fromUniverse]->(universe:FictionalUniverse)<-[:fromUniverse]-(org:Organization) WHERE org.name <> "Infinity Watch" RETURN org.name
MATCH (c:Character)-[:diedIn]->(l:Location {name: "Twins"}) OPTIONAL MATCH (victim:Character)-[:killedBy]->(c) RETURN c.name, COUNT(victim) as kill_count
MATCH (stick:Character {name: "Stick"})-[:hasStudent]->(c:Character) RETURN c.name UNION MATCH (c:Character)-[:hasSpouse]-(milla:Character {name: "Milla Donovan"}) RETURN c.name
MATCH (lady:Character {name: "Lady of House Sunderly"}), (victim:Character)-[:hasMother]->(lady), (victim)-[:killedBy]->(killer:Character) RETURN killer.name, COUNT(victim)
MATCH (l:Location) RETURN count(DISTINCT l.name)
MATCH (org:Organization)-[:fromUniverse]->(:FictionalUniverse {name: "World of Ice and Fire"}), (org)-[:basedIn]->(:Location {name: "Kirky Hassary"}) RETURN org.name
MATCH (joffrey:Character {name: "Joffrey Baratheon"})-[:killedBy]->(killer:Character)-[:hasSpouse]->(lysa:Character {name: "Lysa Arryn"}) RETURN killer.name
MATCH (c:Character)-[:hasFather]->(:Character {name: "Aerys II Targaryen"}) RETURN c.name UNION MATCH (c:Character)-[:bornIn]->(:Location {name: "Dragonstone"}) RETURN c.name
MATCH (org:Organization {name: "Planet Express"})-[:basedIn]->(loc:Location) RETURN loc.name
MATCH (victim:Character)-[:killedBy]->(:Character {name: "Petyr Baelish"}), (:Character {name: "Robert Arryn"})-[:hasMother]->(victim) RETURN victim.name, victim.birth_name
MATCH (nate:Character {name: "Nate Grey"})-[:hasMother|hasFather]->(parent:Character)-[:hasSpouse]-(cyclops:Character {name: "Cyclops"}) RETURN parent.name, parent.birth_name
MATCH (c:Character)-[:hasSpouse]->(:Character) RETURN DISTINCT c.creator
MATCH (c:Character)-[:diedIn]->(l:Location {name: "Kirky Hassary"}) RETURN c.name UNION MATCH (c:Character)-[:bornIn]->(l:Location {name: "Tower of Joy"}) RETURN c.name
MATCH (mother:Character {name: "Downy O'Drake"})<-[:hasMother]-(child:Character) OPTIONAL MATCH (grandchild:Character)-[:hasFather]->(child) RETURN child.name, count(grandchild) as father_count

MATCH (killed:Character)-[killedBy]->(ramsay:Character {name: "Ramsay Bolton"}), (killed)-[hasFather]->(father:Character) WITH father, COUNT(killed) as killed_children_count RETURN father.name, killed_children_count
MATCH (c:Character)-[:diedIn]->(l:Location {name: "Yuqing Guan"}) RETURN c.name
MATCH (c:Character)-[:bornIn]->(loc:Location {name: 'Oldtown'}), (c)-[:hasMother]->(mother:Character {name: 'Rhea Florent'}) RETURN c.name, c.gender
MATCH (c:Character)-[:memberOf]->(:Organization {name: "Mandarin's Minions"}) WITH c MATCH (c)-[:memberOf]->(o:Organization) RETURN c.name, COUNT(o)
MATCH (child:Character)-[:bornIn]->(loc:Location {name: "Pyke"}), (child)-[:hasFather]->(father:Character) RETURN father.name, count(child)
MATCH (jaehaerys:Character {name: "Jaehaerys II Targaryen"})<-[:hasFather]-(killer:Character)<-[:killedBy]-(victim:Character) RETURN victim.name, victim.occupation
MATCH (c:Character)-[:hasSpouse]->(robb:Character {name: "Robb Stark"}), (c)-[:fromUniverse]->(:FictionalUniverse {name: "World of Ice and Fire"}) RETURN COUNT(DISTINCT c)

MATCH (c:Character)-[:memberOf]->(org:Organization {name: "The Assembly of Evil"}), (c)-[:memberOf]->(otherOrg:Organization) WHERE otherOrg.name <> "The Assembly of Evil" RETURN COUNT(DISTINCT otherOrg)
MATCH (child:Character)-[:hasFather]->(father:Character), (child)-[:killedBy]->(father) RETURN DISTINCT father.name, father.occupation
MATCH (child:Character)-[:hasFather|:hasMother]->(parent:Character {name: "J. Jonah Jameson"}) RETURN child.name
MATCH (mattie:Character {name: "Mattie Franklin"})-[hasFather]->(father:Character) RETURN father.name, father.country_of_citizenship
MATCH (c:Character)-[:diedIn]->(:Location {name: "Yiling"}) OPTIONAL MATCH (victim:Character)-[:killedBy]->(c) RETURN c.name, COUNT(victim) AS kill_count
MATCH (c:Character)-[:diedIn]->(:Location {name: "Xuzhou"}) OPTIONAL MATCH (child:Character)-[:hasFather]->(c) RETURN c.name, count(child)

MATCH (matsu:Character {name: "Matsu'o Tsurayaba"})-[:memberOf]->(org:Organization) MATCH (char:Character)-[:memberOf]->(org) WHERE char.name <> "Matsu'o Tsurayaba" RETURN char.name, COUNT(org) as org_count
MATCH (c:Character)-[:killedBy]->(:Character {name: "Bian Hong"}), (c)-[:hasSpouse]->(:Character {name: "Lady Xu"}) RETURN c.name
MATCH (ladyHe:Character {name: "Lady He"})-[:hasSpouse]->(spouse:Character)-[:hasMother]->(mother:Character) RETURN mother.name
MATCH (c:Character)-[:fromUniverse]->(u:FictionalUniverse {name: "Forest"}) RETURN c.name
MATCH (c:Character)-[:fromUniverse]->(:FictionalUniverse {name: "Marvel Universe"}) OPTIONAL MATCH (c)-[:memberOf]->(org:Organization) RETURN c.name, COUNT(org) as organization_count
MATCH (child:Character)-[:diedIn]->(:Location {name: "The North"}), (child)-[:hasFather]->(father:Character) RETURN father.name, count(child) AS child_count

MATCH (yuno:Character {name: "Yuno Gasai"}) MATCH (student:Character) <-[:hasStudent]- (teacher:Character) -[:killedBy]-> (yuno) RETURN student.name, COUNT(teacher) AS teacher_count ORDER BY student.name

MATCH (c:Character) OPTIONAL MATCH (zg:Character {name: "Zhao Guang"})-[hasFather]->(c) WITH c, zg OPTIONAL MATCH (sy:Character {name: "Su Yong"})-[killedBy]->(c) WHERE zg IS NOT NULL OR sy IS NOT NULL RETURN COUNT(DISTINCT c)
MATCH (c1:Character {name: "Mu Shun"})-[:diedIn]->(l:Location)<-[:diedIn]-(c2:Character {name: "Geng Ji"}) RETURN l.name
MATCH (victim:Character)-[:killedBy]->(killer:Character {name: "Liao Hua"}) WHERE "Han" IN victim.country_of_citizenship RETURN victim.name
MATCH (c:Character)-[:hasSpouse]-(s:Character), (c)-[:killedBy]->(s) RETURN DISTINCT c.creator
MATCH (:Character)-[:bornIn]->(l:Location) RETURN COUNT(DISTINCT l)
MATCH (xforce:Organization {name: "X-Force"})<-[:memberOf]-(char:Character)-[:memberOf]->(org:Organization) WHERE org.name <> "X-Force" RETURN org.name, COUNT(char) as member_count
MATCH (o:Organization)-[:fromUniverse]->(u:FictionalUniverse {name: "Rosario + Vampire"}) RETURN o.name
MATCH (c:Character)-[:killedBy]->(sl:Character {name: "Sun Lin"}), (eq:Character {name: "Empress Quan"})-[:hasFather]->(c) RETURN c.name, c.gender

MATCH (burglar:Character {name: 'Burglar'}), (auntMay:Character {name: 'Aunt May'}), (c:Character) WHERE (c)-[:killedBy]->(burglar) OR (c)-[:hasSpouse]->(auntMay) OR (auntMay)-[:hasSpouse]->(c) RETURN COUNT(DISTINCT c)
MATCH (c:Character)-[:bornIn]->(l:Location {name: "Xandar"}), (c)-[:memberOf]->(o:Organization {name: "Nova Corps"}) RETURN count(DISTINCT c.gender)
MATCH (c1:Character {name: "Rhaenys Targaryen"})-[:bornIn]->(l1:Location), (c2:Character {name: "Aegon III Targaryen"})-[:bornIn]->(l2:Location) RETURN l1.name, l2.name
MATCH (dwight:Character {name: "Dwight Conrad"}) -[:hasMother]-> (mother:Character) -[:hasSpouse]-> (hermes:Character {name: "Hermes Conrad"}) RETURN mother.name, mother.creator
MATCH (c:Character)-[:bornIn]->(l:Location {name: "Twins"}) RETURN DISTINCT c.name
MATCH (c:Character)-[:bornIn]->(l:Location {name: "Riverrun"}), (c)-[:killedBy]->(killer:Character {name: "Petyr Baelish"}) RETURN c.name
MATCH (c:Character)-[:hasFather]->(:Character) UNWIND c.country_of_citizenship AS country RETURN DISTINCT country

MATCH (c:Character) WHERE (c)-[:hasSpouse]->(:Character {name: "Shiklah"}) OR (:Character {name: "Shiklah"})-[:hasSpouse]->(c) OR (c)-[:memberOf]->(:Organization {name: "Mercs for Money"}) RETURN DISTINCT c.name
MATCH (o:Organization)-[:basedIn]->(l:Location) RETURN COUNT(DISTINCT l)
